entries.title: Is a Caterpillar a NYMPH? The Butterfly's Secret Stage (Part A)

moments.what: Round 1: is the caterpillar a nymph like the young grasshopper?
A caterpillar looks nothing like a butterfly
Count the caterpillar's legs: six legs at the front
The stumps at the back are called prolegs
Prolegs have tiny hooks that grip the twig
Journey: be a butterfly egg, hatch, munch, moult and grow
The butterfly larva is also called a caterpillar
HOLD ON! The pupa is busy inside its case
This stage is called the pupa
Inside the pupal case, the body changes into a butterfly
The pupal case splits and out comes the adult butterfly
The butterfly has four stages: egg, larva, pupa and adult
The young of these animals look different from the adult

entries.title: What's WRIGGLING in This Pail of Rainwater? (Part B)

moments.what: Round 1: what comes after the wriggler?
Wrigglers hang just under the water's surface
A little tube at the tail end lets the wriggler get air
The mosquito larva is also called a wriggler
Journey: be a mosquito egg, a wriggler, a pupa, then an adult
After the wriggler comes the pupa
A life cycle with four stages: egg, larva, pupa and adult
Showdown: check Basil's homework on the mosquito
Only some kinds of mosquitoes spread dengue
Dengue is a sickness that gives people a high fever
Mosquito eggs are laid in stagnant water
Stagnant water is still water that nobody changes
Tip out still water to stop new mosquitoes
Remove breeding spots in our schools and homes
